## Build

The top-level build script is `CMakeLists.txt` at the repository root (`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)`, `project(filemanager)`).

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
sudo cmake --install build
```

## Dependencies

`Build-Depends` in `debian/control` lists 15 entries; the first 8 are listed below (see `debian/control` for the complete list):

- `cmake`
- `debhelper (>= 9)`
- `extra-cmake-modules`
- `lingmoui3`
- `libkf6kio-dev`
- `libkf6solid-dev`
- `libkf6windowsystem-dev`
- `libkf6config-dev`

The top-level `CMakeLists.txt` looks up 8 packages with `find_package`: `Qt6`, `LingmoUI`, `KF6KIO`, `KF6Solid`, `KF6WindowSystem`, `KF6Config`, `KF6XmlGui`, `LingmoUI3`.
